engagementGoals.comments: questions, contrarian takes, controlled comparisons, false binaries

formulas.name: Platform Risk Anaphora
formulas.shape: Repeat one stem to stack the risks of depending on something the reader does not control, then name what they do control.

formulas.name: Category Obituary
formulas.shape: Declare a named practice finished, say precisely what killed it, name what replaces it. A quotable distinction, not a rant.

formulas.name: Year-over-Year Pivot
formulas.shape: What was true last year, what changed, what that forces the reader to do differently now.

formulas.name: Time-Anchor Confession
formulas.shape: A dated moment you got something wrong, what it cost, what you do instead now.

formulas.name: Self-Proving Meta
formulas.shape: The post demonstrates the thing it argues for, so the format is the evidence.

formulas.name: Odd-Precision Ledger
formulas.shape: An itemised breakdown with unrounded real figures. Only usable with numbers you can cite.

formulas.name: Paid-vs-Free Reversal
formulas.shape: The expensive option most people buy, against the cheap thing that actually fixes it.

formulas.name: Curiosity-Gap Teaser
formulas.shape: Name a surprising outcome, withhold the mechanism for one beat, then deliver it in full. Never leave the gap open.

formulas.name: Contrarian With Receipts
formulas.shape: State the widely held view, say why it fails in this specific context, show the mechanism that beats it.

formulas.name: Emotional Cold-Open
formulas.shape: Open inside a concrete charged moment, no preamble, then widen to the lesson.

formulas.name: Permission Slip
formulas.shape: Name the thing the reader secretly wants to stop doing, and give them the reason it is fine to stop.

formulas.name: Bait-and-Switch Reversal
formulas.shape: Set up the expected conclusion, then turn it on the real one.

formulas.name: Named Gratitude
formulas.shape: Credit a specific person or team for a specific thing, with the detail that makes it real.

formulas.name: Explain-to-Kids Simplification
formulas.shape: Strip a technical mechanism to language a smart twelve-year-old follows, keeping every load-bearing part.

formulas.name: Status-Strip Humility
formulas.shape: Drop the credential, show the unglamorous work underneath it.

formulas.name: Controlled A/B Anecdote
formulas.shape: Two near-identical situations, one variable different, the outcomes that diverged.

formulas.name: False-Binary Dissolve
formulas.shape: Name the either/or everyone argues about, show why both sides share a wrong assumption, give the third option.

formulas.name: Evidence Bridge
formulas.shape: Open on one concrete case, bridge to the general pattern, close on what it predicts.

formulas.name: Diverging-Curves Close
formulas.shape: Two things that look alike today and compound apart, with the mechanism that separates them.
